verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS scheduling platform, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints, or data-purge features. The GDPR/CCPA compliance claims and the self-hostable Cal.diy edition are adjacent: certifications and owning your own infrastructure are not a product-provided retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
